FEATURE / WORLDBUILDER / ROAD PRESENTATION QUALITY FOLLOW-UP: The reusable road-network architecture from closed SceneIssue `20260829-024238-000-WorldBuilderRoadNetworkIntegration` is complete and must remain authoritative. Do NOT reopen, replace, fork, or duplicate its semantic graph, deterministic route resolver, grading/cut-fill constraints, shared 0..31 road influence, vegetation integration, navigation/travel semantics, or bounded `EmitTerrainCorridor` lowering. This issue is a visual/presentation-quality follow-up driven by human review of that feature's final exact built-player evidence, run `33296430341` (`RealPlayer/FullResolutionScreenshots/showcase-002-t039.3s-walking.png`, `showcase-003-t049.3s-walking.png`, and `showcase-004-t059.3s-survey.png`). The final road is connected and the former checker/stair-step material defect is fixed, but the rendered result still reads as prototype-quality rather than the repository's AAA art/layout bar.

OBSERVED DEFECTS FROM FINAL BUILT EVIDENCE: (1) curved road silhouettes remain visibly voxel/sawtooth rather than reading as coherent organic curves; (2) shoulders blend continuously but often look smeared/blob-like rather than like believable worn roadside transition; (3) the carriageway is visually flat and uniform, with little readable breakup such as compacted center, wheel wear/ruts, gravel/stone variation, erosion, or edge encroachment; (4) junctions and settlement approaches can read as irregular brown puddles rather than intentionally constructed connected road geometry; (5) apparent width/edge definition varies too much between segments and views; (6) roads do not strongly express a believable terrain cross-section such as crown/camber, shallow drainage, cut bank, fill shoulder/berm, or other profile-appropriate shaping; and (7) surrounding terrain/material transitions sometimes amplify the artificial look, so road presentation must remain robust on uneven/sloped terrain and at medium/far LOD.

PRIMARY GOAL: Add a reusable WorldBuilder road-presentation capability that turns the existing resolved `WorldRoadNetwork` + shared road influence into visually convincing voxel roads without changing road topology or creating a parallel renderer. The same semantic road should remain authoritative; this work should improve how its geometry/profile and surface response are realized and rendered. A Dirt road through Grass should read as a deliberately formed, traveled road embedded in terrain rather than a uniformly brown painted ribbon.

ARCHITECTURE BOUNDARY: Start from the existing production owners (`WorldRoadNetwork`, road profile data, terrain corridor lowering/rasterization, packed terrain surface blend metadata, SmoothSurface rendering/material response, vegetation/ecology, streaming/LOD). Generalize those systems where needed. Do not add Kentridge-only geometry, scene-local voxel edits, per-road/per-segment GameObjects, non-destructible cover meshes, dense decal strips, or a road-only shader island. If richer presentation data is required, add the smallest reusable profile/terrain-surface contract that can also serve trails, village roads, mountain roads, causeway approaches, and similar WorldBuilder consumers. Preserve deterministic seed behavior, chunk/region independence, destructibility, collision, storage semantics, and semantic route traceability.

REUSABLE ROAD CROSS-SECTION / GEOMETRY: Extend or formalize road profile realization so a road can express an intentional cross-section appropriate to its class. At minimum investigate/profile: stable carriageway width, optional crown/camber or center shaping, shoulder falloff, shallow roadside drainage or edge depression where terrain allows, cut-bank treatment on uphill sides, and fill/berm/support treatment on downhill sides. These must be bounded terrain-authoring operations driven from the existing centerline/influence rather than hand-authored roadside strips. Cross-section behavior must degrade safely on narrow trails, tight curves, junctions, steep terrain, cliffs, and near structures rather than causing overlaps, inaccessible ledges, or huge terrain edits.

CURVE / EDGE QUALITY: Remove the strong sawtooth/voxel-stair silhouette visible on curved roads at normal player and survey distances. Preserve authoritative voxel terrain; do not hide the edge beneath an unrelated mesh. Prefer improvements through the shared density/surface reconstruction path, analytic corridor geometry, constrained sub-voxel/smooth-surface semantics, coherent edge shaping, or equivalent reusable mechanisms. Edge irregularity may break mathematical perfection but must be spatially coherent and must not make road width visibly pulse, produce isolated blobs, or create disconnected shoulders. Curves and diagonals must remain continuous across region/chunk/LOD boundaries.

SURFACE MATERIAL / WEAR PRESENTATION: Add reusable deterministic road-surface variation so a carriageway is not one flat brown response. The exact solution should fit the existing constrained material system rather than becoming arbitrary splat maps. Useful reusable cues may include compacted/worn center response, wheel-track/rut bands, gravel/stone breakup, exposed local substrate, subtle edge erosion, grass encroachment/recovery, or profile-specific roughness/normal/detail variation. Material variation must be world-space deterministic, bounded, stable across chunks/LOD, and integrated through shared terrain material response. It must not alter collision/density unintentionally, abuse coating displacement, or create per-frame allocations/material instances. Different road/trail profiles should be able to choose restrained variants without duplicating shaders.

SHOULDERS / TERRAIN INTEGRATION: Retain the existing continuous Dirt↔local-terrain blend but improve its visual structure. Both shoulders should read as believable transitions shaped by terrain and road use rather than broad smeared brown/green blobs. Preserve local terrain material authority outside the road influence and preserve exposed-top/slope correctness so Grass is not smeared onto cliff walls. Vegetation suppression/recovery should remain driven by the existing shared influence and should visually agree with the final road edge/profile. Roadside shaping must not erase nearby authored features, entrances, foundations, waterways, or reserved corridors.

JUNCTIONS / INTERSECTIONS: Junctions, forks, settlement approaches, and close parallel segments must produce intentional road geometry. Avoid puddle-like merged material areas, narrow pinches, abrupt width expansion, triangular gaps, self-overlap artifacts, or disconnected shoulders. Use the existing semantic/resolved network topology to distinguish actual junctions from merely nearby segments. A junction should have bounded deterministic blending/profile resolution with clear traversable circulation and consistent surface treatment.

LOD / STREAMING / FAR-FIELD: The improved presentation must remain coherent from player height through medium/far survey views. No material popping, edge discontinuity, road disappearance, disconnected segment, width jump, chunk seam, or LOD-specific checker/stair pattern may appear. Preserve the road network's current streaming model and bounded one-primitive-per-piece intent where possible; if extra presentation work is required, quantify the added primitive/voxel/vertex/material cost and keep it bounded. Do not force the entire road network into high-detail residency.

BEHAVIORAL REGRESSIONS: Add focused production-path tests that prove the underlying road semantics remain unchanged while presentation improves. At minimum cover: (1) fixed semantic route/seed still resolves to the same logical connection and deterministic centerline/profile intent unless a documented presentation-only profile extension requires a stable version change; (2) cross-section width/crown/shoulder behavior remains bounded and traversable on flat, sloped, diagonal, and curved segments; (3) both sides of a road produce stable terrain-aware shoulder/cut/fill behavior; (4) junction composition is deterministic and topology-aware; (5) material/wear variation is deterministic, chunk-safe, and presentation-only where intended; (6) exposed-top/slope material semantics remain correct; (7) vegetation still suppresses/recoveries from the same shared influence; (8) no region/chunk/LOD seam changes road continuity; (9) persisted voxel/storage and `SmoothSurfaceVertex` budgets do not grow without an explicit measured justification; and (10) ordinary non-road terrain/material/coating behavior remains unchanged.

VISUAL / BUILT-APPLICATION VALIDATION IS MANDATORY: This issue may not close from structural tests, primitive counts, debug overlays, or a survey shot alone. Validate the exact built `KentridgePlayableSlice` through normal player movement and inspect full-resolution captures. Required evidence must include: (a) player-height approach along a curved/diagonal road showing a coherent non-sawtooth edge; (b) close player-height view of both shoulders on uneven/sloped terrain showing believable local-terrain recovery without smear, repeated bands, or hard lines; (c) close and medium views of at least one real junction/settlement approach proving intentional width and intersection shaping with no puddle-like material blob; (d) a segment on non-flat terrain demonstrating believable road cross-section/cut/fill/edge treatment without floating or inaccessible geometry; (e) medium/far survey showing multiple connected roads with stable width/material and no chunk/LOD seam; (f) vegetation recovery that agrees visually with the road edge; and (g) normal CharacterMotor traversal through the inspected road/junction sections. Human visual review of these exact built-player captures is required before pending/closure.

ACCEPTANCE: (1) the closed shared road-network architecture remains the sole semantic/route authority; (2) curved/diagonal roads no longer show a distracting voxel sawtooth silhouette at normal viewing distances; (3) carriageway and shoulders read as a deliberately formed road embedded in terrain rather than a flat uniformly painted ribbon; (4) reusable surface variation/wear provides materially richer road readability without a road-only shader/material-instance island; (5) road cross-section and terrain integration provide believable bounded shaping on representative flat and sloped cases; (6) junctions/approaches read as intentional traversable intersections without puddle-like blobs, pinches, gaps, or width explosions; (7) local terrain material, slope/exposed-top behavior, vegetation, collision, destructibility, semantic queryability, streaming, and LOD remain correct; (8) focused regressions prove deterministic bounded profile/material/junction behavior and protect non-road consumers; (9) exact built-player evidence covers player-height curves, both shoulders, a junction, non-flat cross-section, and medium/far continuity and passes human visual review at the repository's AAA bar; and (10) CPU/GPU, world-build, voxel-write, resident-memory, vertex/material, primitive, and streaming costs are measured and remain within existing budgets without weakening them.

NON-GOALS: Replacing the road semantic graph or route solver; redesigning Kentridge's topology; adding lane/traffic simulation; arbitrary N-way terrain splat maps; photorealistic asphalt-only infrastructure; hiding voxel geometry under non-authoritative meshes; scene-local art patches; or reopening `20260829-024238-000-WorldBuilderRoadNetworkIntegration`. This ticket is the reusable visual-quality/presentation layer on top of the already-completed road system.
